note: variable NAMES only, project-level .codex/hooks.json (not a plugin hook); values redacted. Captured with codex exec launched FROM a Claude Code Bash tool: the hook process inherits the parent environment whole, so every CLAUDE_* variable below belongs to the PARENT Claude Code session, not to Codex. CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID here is the Claude session's id, which is why a hook that names its state after that variable mixes a Codex session into a Claude one (CR-120).
